title: Scenic level, version 1
description: Structure of an authored 3D level. Units are metres, +Y is up, the ground is the XZ plane, and objects face along local -Z. Relationships between objects (unique IDs, parents, sibling order, references) are checked by `scenic-cli validate`, not by this schema.

camera.description: ID of the camera object that supplies the game's initial view, or null to use the game's own camera.

objects.description: A flat collection. Hierarchy comes from `parent`; file order is not meaningful.

id.description: Stable, unique UUID. Scenic and scenic-cli generate it.

parent.description: ID of the parent object, or null for a root object.

order.description: Zero-based position among siblings; contiguous per parent.

transform.description: Relative to the parent. world = parent * translate * rotate * scale.

rotation.description: Euler degrees [x, y, z], applied as roll (Z), then pitch (X), then yaw (Y). Default [0, 0, 0].

shape.description: Unscaled dimensions in metres, centred on the local origin. Box: size [x, y, z]. Plane: size [x, z] on local XZ. Sphere: radius. Cylinder: radius and height along local Y. Primitives only.

appearance.description: Unlit look of a primitive. The texture is multiplied by the color.

texture.description: Path relative to the assets directory, such as textures/crate.png.

camera.description: Lens of a camera object. It looks along local -Z with local +Y up.

fov.description: Vertical field of view in degrees. Default 45.

size.description: Orthographic vertical size in metres. Default 10.

properties.description: Game-specific data, preserved as written. An object of the form {"$ref": "<object id>"} is a reference to another object.
